kurals.tr: Thakudhi Enavondru Nandre Pakudhiyaal / Paarpattu Ozhukap Perin
kurals.m: That equity which consists in acting with equal regard to each of (the three) divisions of men [enemies, strangers and friends] is a pre-eminent virtue

kurals.tr: Seppam Utaiyavan Aakkanj Chidhaivindri / Echchaththir Kemaappu Utaiththu
kurals.m: The wealth of the man of rectitude will not perish, but will bring happiness also to his posterity

kurals.tr: Nandre Tharinum Natuvikandhaam Aakkaththai / Andre Yozhiya Vital
kurals.m: Forsake in the very moment (of acquisition) that gain which, though it should bring advantage, is without equity

kurals.tr: Thakkaar Thakavilar Enpadhu Avaravar / Echchaththaar Kaanap Patum
kurals.m: The worthy and unworthy may be known by the existence or otherwise of good offsprings

kurals.tr: Ketum Perukkamum Illalla Nenjaththuk / Kotaamai Saandrork Kani
kurals.m: Loss and gain come not without cause; it is the ornament of the wise to preserve evenness of mind (under both)

kurals.tr: Ketuvalyaan Enpadhu Arikadhan Nenjam / Natuvoreei Alla Seyin
kurals.m: Let him whose mind departing from equity commits sin well consider thus within himself, "I shall perish."

kurals.tr: Ketuvaaka Vaiyaadhu Ulakam Natuvaaka / Nandrikkan Thangiyaan Thaazhvu
kurals.m: The great will not regard as poverty the low estate of that man who dwells in the virtue of equity

kurals.tr: Samanseydhu Seerdhookkung Kolpol Amaindhorupaal / Kotaamai Saandrork Kani
kurals.m: To incline to neither side, but to rest impartial as the even-fixed scale is the ornament of the wise

kurals.tr: Sorkottam Illadhu Seppam Orudhalaiyaa / Utkottam Inmai Perin
kurals.m: Freedom from obliquity of speech is rectitude, if there be (corresponding) freedom from bias of mind

kurals.tr: Vaanikam Seyvaarkku Vaanikam Penip / Piravum Thamapol Seyin
kurals.m: The true merchandize of merchants is to guard and do by the things of others as they do by their own
